items.title: 10.8 Electrolysis ke doran jama hone wale madde ki miqdar (mass) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.8, printed pages 221-222.

blocks.text: Electrolysis ke doran electrode par banne wale madde ki mass us waqt ke mutanasib hai jis tak mustaqil current guzre aur current ki taqat ke. Current aur waqt ko mila kar: Q = I x t, jahan Q coulombs (C) mein charge, I amperes (A) mein current aur t seconds (s) mein waqt hai. Electrode par banne (ya us se hatne) wale madde ki mass electrolyte se guzarne wali bijli ki miqdar (coulombs) ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.title: Faraday
blocks.text: Bijli ki miqdar aksar Faradays (symbol F) mein likhi jati hai. Ek Faraday woh bijli ka charge hai jo 1 mole electrons ya 1 mole ek-charge wale ions le jate hain; us ki qeemat 96500 C mol-1 hai.

Silver nitrate solution ki electrolysis ke doran cathode par silver jama hoti hai, Ag+(aq) + e- se Ag(s), 1 mol ions, 1 mol electrons aur 1 mol metal: 1 Faraday (96500 C) 1 mole silver jama karta hai. Copper(II) sulfate solution ki electrolysis ke doran, Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s), fi mole copper 2 moles electrons chahiye, to 2 Faradays (2 x 96500 C) 1 mole copper jama karte hain. Faradays ki tadaad hasil ya khoye gaye electrons ke moles ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: 108 g silver, 63.5 g copper aur 27 g aluminium jama karne ko kitne Faradays chahiye (exercise Q.2i)?
blocks.explanation: Har mass ek mole hai. Ag+ ko 1 mole electrons chahiye: 1 F. Cu2+ ko 2: 2 F. Al3+ ko 3: 3 F.

items: Q = I x t (C = A x s); jama mass guzre charge ke mutanasib hai. 1 Faraday = 96500 C = 1 mol electrons ka charge; Ag+ ko fi mole 1 F, Cu2+ ko 2 F; Faradays = electrons ke moles.
